en.headline: Elderly pedestrian critically injured after private minibus collision in To Kwa Wan
en.dek: A 75-year-old man was knocked down at the junction of Lok Shan Road and Mei Sin Tong Road around 10am and taken unconscious to Queen Elizabeth Hospital; the driver remained at the scene.
body: Police said a private minibus collided with a male pedestrian at the junction of Lok Shan Road and Mei Sin Tong Road in To Kwa Wan at about 10.06am on Thursday. The 75-year-old man was found unconscious and was taken by ambulance to Queen Elizabeth Hospital for treatment.

Witness accounts indicated the minibus had been travelling along Lok Shan Road and turning right into Mei Sin Tong Road when its front right side struck the man who was crossing the road. A bloodstain and a smashed watermelon were left at the scene. The vehicle bore markings of a Christian family service centre.
The male driver of the minibus stayed at the scene to assist the investigation. Police are examining the circumstances of the collision and have not announced any arrest.

zh.headline: 土瓜灣私家小巴撞倒七旬途人 重傷昏迷送院
zh.dek: 75歲男子周四上午約10時在落山道與美善同道交界被撞倒昏迷，送伊利沙伯醫院搶救；小巴男司機在場協助調查。
body: 警方表示，周四上午約10時06分，一輛私家小巴在土瓜灣落山道與美善同道交界撞倒一名過路男途人。75歲男子倒地昏迷，由救護車送往伊利沙伯醫院治理。
現場消息指，涉事小巴沿落山道右轉入美善同道時，右邊車頭撞到正在過馬路的事主。地上留下血迹及一個爆裂的西瓜。小巴車身印有「基督教家庭服務中心」字句。
小巴男司機事後在場協助調查，警方正了解意外成因，暫未有人被捕。
